overview: The paper proposes Adaptive Early-Stop Loss (AESL), a lightweight cold-start SFT method that dynamically balances acquiring new reasoning patterns with preserving the base model's distribution at token and subsequence levels, to better prepare LLMs for subsequent RL post-training.

modules.name: AESL Loss Function Core
modules.description: Implements the Adaptive Early-Stop Loss, including the adaptive weighting function p(q, s*_t, π_θ) that combines token-level early-stopping via softmax over logits and subsequence-level scaling via average prefix log-probability, with configurable temperature scaling hyperparameter.

modules.name: Diversity Metrics Computation
modules.description: Implements entropy and self-BLEU computation for measuring response diversity. Entropy is computed from the model's token-level probability distribution, and self-BLEU is computed by comparing generated samples against each other within the same prompt group.

modules.name: Diversity-Based Early Stopping Criterion
modules.description: Implements the early-stopping logic that monitors diversity metrics (entropy and self-BLEU) during SFT cold-start training and identifies the turning point where diversity peaks, indicating the onset of base distribution forgetting, to select the optimal checkpoint for RL.

modules.name: GRPO RL Training Algorithm
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization objective for RL post-training, including the clipped surrogate objective, group-normalized advantage estimation, and KL divergence penalty against the reference policy.

modules.name: Cold-Start Dataset Subsampling and Verification
modules.description: Handles uniform subsampling of demonstrations from the Openr1-Math-46k dataset, pairing each question with one verified demonstration using Math-Verify, and supporting different subsample sizes (1k, 3k, 6k).

modules.name: Question Difficulty Filtering
modules.description: Implements question difficulty ranking using the base model's average accuracy over multiple rollouts per question, then constructs hard and simple splits based on the ranking for difficulty-aware cold-start experiments.

modules.name: General Reasoning Dataset Curation
modules.description: Handles filtering and mixing of general reasoning demonstrations from OpenThoughts-114k with mathematical demonstrations from Openr1-Math, including filtering out coding tasks with non-boxed output formats and combining subsamples.

modules.name: Custom SFT Training Loop with AESL Integration
modules.description: Implements the SFT cold-start training loop integrating AESL loss, including epoch management, gradient accumulation, learning rate scheduling with cosine decay and warmup, and periodic evaluation for checkpoint selection.

modules.name: RL Post-Training Loop with GRPO
modules.description: Implements the RL training phase using GRPO, including group rollout generation, reward computation from verifiers, advantage normalization within groups, policy updates with clipped objective, and KL-penalized optimization.

modules.name: RoPE Context Extension
modules.description: Implements Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) theta adjustment and window size expansion to support longer output sequences during training and inference for models with limited default context length.

modules.name: Mathematical Reasoning Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Implements evaluation on mathematical benchmarks (AIME24/25, AMC23, MATH-500, Minerva Math, OlympiadBench) with avg@64 metric for small test sets and pass@1 for larger ones, including answer extraction from boxed format.

modules.name: General Reasoning Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Implements evaluation on general reasoning benchmarks (ARC-C, GPQA-Diamond, MMLU-Pro) with appropriate metric computation and macro-averaging across benchmarks.

modules.name: Baseline Methods Integration
modules.description: Integrates baseline cold-start methods including standard CE loss with best-checkpoint selection, CE with diversity-based early stopping (CE-ES), GEM for diversity preservation, and PSFT for out-of-distribution generalization.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Implements ablation experiments for AESL components, including variants with constant denominator, rank-based token masking for top-1 predictions, and linear inverse weighting, as well as hyperparameter sensitivity analysis for the temperature scaling parameter.

modules.name: Distribution Alignment and Word Frequency Analysis
modules.description: Implements cross-distribution analysis tools including BLEU score computation between pre- and post-cold-start outputs to measure distribution shift, and word frequency/cloud analysis to compare vocabulary patterns and detect memorization artifacts across different cold-start methods.
